svg.aria-label: Constructed homogeneous equal-contrast spheres, 10 and 30 nm, number fractions 99.9% and 0.1%, using Rayleigh sixth-power weights. PDI is normalized decay-rate variance. C fits a second-order expansion of noiseless log field correlation to expose truncation error, not instrument performance.
